artworks.title: Perseus with the Head of Medusa
artworks.description: Cellini's Loggia bronze — Perseus astride Medusa's body with the severed head aloft, the cycle's Gorgon climax cast for Cosimo's Florence.

artworks.title: Medusa
artworks.description: Caravaggio's shield Medusa — the severed head frozen mid-scream, Perseus' trophy as a tournament-piece of terror.

artworks.title: Perseus and Andromeda
artworks.description: Titian's poesie of the Ethiopian rescue — Perseus diving on the sea-monster while Andromeda strains at her chains.

artworks.title: Perseus and Andromeda
artworks.description: Leighton's Victorian spectacle — Perseus airborne above Andromeda as the dragon coils, Athena's gifts implied in the flight.

films.title: Clash of the Titans
films.description: Harryhausen's peplum restages the Perseus cycle for modern screens — Medusa, Pegasus and the Kraken as stop-motion myth.

popCulture.title: Perseus
popCulture.description: The Argive hero's cycle — Gorgon, Andromeda, the gift of Medusa's head — remains one of myth's most filmed quests.
